title: Per-adapter delivery work status
description: Read-only, metadata-only per-adapter work summary as reported by `medre inspect work-status`. One current outbox generation per delivery identity (event, delivery plan, target adapter, target channel) is selected by the shared current-delivery authority rule and classified into one closed category whose counts never overlap and sum to the current-generation total. Retained non-current generations and receipt history are separate dimensions and never count as outstanding work. The projection reads local durable storage only: it proves neither adapter connectivity, recorded-owner liveness, that a native send occurred, nor recipient delivery, and it never claims a `sent` state as independent recipient observation.

sampled_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant used as the comparison time for every due and lease comparison in the report.

adapter_filter.description: Target adapter every aggregate is scoped to, or null for all adapters. A filtered report states the scope instead of zero-filling the world.

definition.description: Fixed definition text shipped with the report so offline consumers can interpret the projection without the source module.

totals.description: Category partition summed over the reported adapters. The seven categories are non-overlapping; their sum equals current_generations, and outstanding is the sum of the four non-terminal categories.

unstarted_eligible.description: Pending generations, plus retry_wait generations whose due time has passed: claimable by a worker at the sampled time.

retry_scheduled.description: retry_wait generations whose due time is in the future at the sampled time.

reserved_active.description: Generations claimed or reserved by a dispatch owner. Ownership is a recorded fact, not proof of owner liveness or of a native send.

native_queue.description: Generations handed to an adapter-local queue: local acceptance evidence awaiting correlated feedback.

uncertain_outcome.description: abandoned generations: terminal with native acceptance never settled.

terminal_outcome.description: Generations settled as sent, dead_lettered, or cancelled. sent records local acceptance only.

unrecognized.description: Fail-closed bucket for a persisted status outside the stored vocabulary; the storage CHECK constraint prevents it in practice.

current_generations.description: Total current generations within scope; equals the sum of the seven categories.

outstanding.description: Sum of the four non-terminal categories: generations a worker, queue, or schedule may still act on.

adapters.description: One summary per target adapter with current generations, ordered by adapter name.

categories.description: The closed category partition for this adapter's current generations; sums to current_generations.

oldest_outstanding.description: The longest-waiting outstanding generation for this adapter, or null when the adapter holds no outstanding work. The age anchor carries a precise origin label.

target_channel.description: Persisted channel, or null for the deliberate no-channel identity.

status.description: Persisted outbox status of the selected generation.

attempt_number.description: Persisted finalized attempt counter, including zero for never-dispatched work.

active_attempt.description: Persisted in-flight attempt reservation, or null.

origin.description: Which recorded fact the age is measured from: admission (created), retry_due (scheduled due time), claim (recorded claim), or queue_admission (adapter queue handoff).

anchor.description: The anchor timestamp exactly as persisted, or null when the row carries no usable timestamp.

age_seconds.description: Whole seconds from the anchor to sampled_at; negative when the anchor is in the future. Null when no usable anchor exists: unknown is not zero.

uncertainty.description: Recorded uncertainty summed across the reported adapters; a separate dimension, never part of the category partition.

raw_outbox_states.description: Stored outbox status counts over every retained row in scope, including superseded generations. A raw separate dimension, never a category sum.

retained_history.description: Retained history accounting: terminal outcomes and superseded generations stay visible here and never masquerade as outstanding work.

superseded_generations.description: Retained non-current outbox generations within scope.

receipts_by_status.description: Retained receipt counts by status within scope.

limits.description: Fixed honesty limits shipped with every report: what an offline read-only query cannot establish.

uncertainty.description: Recorded-uncertainty observations about current generations; none establishes or excludes a live native send.

reserved_without_generation_receipt.description: Reserved generations whose attempt generation carries no receipt evidence at all: whether a native send occurred is unknown.

lease_missing_or_expired.description: Reserved generations whose recorded lease is missing or expired at the sampled time: the recorded owner's liveness is unknown and the work becomes reclaimable.

stale_queue_reclaimable.description: Queued generations whose last update is older than the storage reclaim grace: adapter-local queue admission may be stale.
